subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world addition and subtraction word problems within 20, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a simple joining or taking-away story using virtual objects
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a simple picture or number bond to represent a one-step word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step addition or subtraction word problem within 20

misconception_flags: picks the wrong operation (adds when the story means taking away, or vice versa)

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
